name: ankka-console-workspace
description: The installation's console: the ankka-console package, the host that is the image, and the browser suite.

scripts.e2e: npm run build && CONSOLE_E2E_PARITY=1 npm test -w e2e --
scripts.build: npm run build -w package && npm run build -w host
scripts.dev: npm run build -w package && npm run dev -w host
